title.en: A recipe target outside its operation's envelope is invalid whatever the readings

goal.en: A recipe may narrow an envelope, never widen it. A simmer at 100 degC, a deep fry at 195 degC or a bake at 110 degC fail before a single reading is looked at.

note.en: Simmer with a target of 100 plus or minus 2: 100 is a boil.
Deep fry at 195 degC: above the 190 ceiling of the band.
Bake at 110 degC: below the 120 floor.
The corrected simmer target, 94 plus or minus 3, passes with the same kind of trace.

cli: printf '[{"t": 0, "tempC": 90}]' > trace.json && cookwala envelope cw.op.simmer trace.json --target 100 --tolerance 2
printf '[{"t": 0, "tempC": 170}]' > trace.json && cookwala envelope cw.op.deep_fry trace.json --target 195 --tolerance 5
cookwala validate   # the repository validator applies the same rule to every recipe target

outcome.en: You know the rule the validator applies to every recipe: targets live inside envelopes. A publisher fixes the recipe; a device never stretches the band. Next: scenario 026 walks a ladder rung by rung.
